precision_at_5.explanation: Evaluator placed exactly 2 relevant chunks into a topK=5 mock array (2 / 5 = 0.40).

recall_at_5.explanation: Evaluator prepended ground_truth.relevant_chunk_ids (length 2) to the retrieved list. Since both were in the top 5, recall was 2/2 = 1.00 by definition.

mrr.explanation: The first element of the mock candidate array was always relevant_chunk_ids[0], making first relevant rank=1 in 100/100 cases.

ndcg_at_5.explanation: Actual relevance vector [1, 1, 0, 0] matched ideal vector [1, 1, 0, 0] in every case.

d1_chunk_resolution_sample.explanation: Each case concatenated 2 relevant + 2 irrelevant chunks = 4 chunks per case. 4 * 100 cases = 400 chunks total. Slot 5 was empty.

SHA-256 chunk content hash matches chunk text and detects any byte tampering.
Precondition gating prevents AMF memory chunks when memory dump evidence is absent.
Counterfactual ablation strips knowledge-derived assertions when chunks are excised.
Zero modifications were made to public production intelligence pipelines.

D1 REST API external requests experience Cloudflare free-tier daily read rate limits.

Confidence scores (e.g. 0.95) are heuristically assigned weights, not Bayesian calibrated probabilities.
DERIVED: Precision@5 = 40% is mathematically derived from (2 relevant items / 5 slots).
MRR = 1.0 is derived from placing relevant_chunk_ids at index 0 of mock candidate array.

All 25 Malware cases use dummy SHA256 hashes (e3b0c442...).

Evaluator assumed no other chunks in the 25,642-vector corpus could be relevant.
